description.text:
Senior System Reliability Engineer | Delta Corp. IT
【The Role】
We're currently seeking an experienced Senior System Reliability Engineer to join Manufacturing Support Team which belongs to Delta Corp. IT. The ideal Engineer would have a passion for improving smart operations and app-building automation.
【Key Responsibilities】
1. Formulate software CI/CD flow.
2. Formulate Backup Plan
3. Build DevOps, include App-Building Automation, Deploy Automation, Monitoring Automation, etc.
4. Record history of operations.
5. Record root cause analysis (RCA), includes Root Cause, Improvement Plan
6. Generate Daily Report which is recording the history of monitoring.
7. Assist operation of the systems.
8. Participate in project analysis, request the requirement of operations.
9. Greatly coordinate with App Develop Team, to stable services, and ensure a smooth flow of DevOps.
【Tech Skill】
<Must>
1. Program language: Shell Script / Golang
2. Operation System: Linux
3. Version Control: Git / GitLab
4. Containerization: Docker / Containerd
<Optional>
1. DevOps: Azure DevOps / GitLab CI/CD
2. Containerization Orchestration: Docker Swarm / Kubernetes
3. IaC Tool: Ansible / Terraform / Helm Chart
4. Observability: Grafana / Prometheus / Grafna Loki / Grafana Tempo
5. Database: Microsoft SQL Server / Oracle DB / MongoDB / Postgresql
6. Backend Application Framework: Spring Boot / .NetCore / Python Flask, Django
7. Frontend Application Framework: Angular / Vue.js / React / jQuery
※職稱與職級會依背景與技術完整度核定。
